image_description: An underwater close-up photograph of a grey whale (Eschrichtius robustus). The image focuses on the head and anterior body, showing the characteristic mottled grey skin covered in white barnacles and cyamids (whale lice). The rostrum is visible with a slight arch, and the pectoral flipper is partially visible near the bottom. No dorsal fin is present, consistent with the species.
